description:
A House Built in Just One Day?! The Amazing Construction Process Using Dozens of Robots

Hello, this is King Process.
At a modular home factory in South Korea, made-to-order homes are produced using robotic automation. Once the blueprints are programmed, robotic arms precisely cut the timber while multiple robots work simultaneously to quickly assemble the wall frames.
After plywood, drywall, and insulation are installed, the finished walls are joined to the floor to complete the structural frame. The factory-built modules are then transported to the construction site and assembled into a complete home.
This video shows the amazing process of dozens of robots completing the frame of a house in just one day. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the video with King Process.
